title: STILL PRESENT (r3): the wrong-person leg's taken-over stand-down is read-time only — the executed UPDATE is still unguarded and the race pin is vacuous

recommended_fix: Wire mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person into apply_wrong_person's awaiting branch; rewrite the race test to POST via handle_wrong_person_post with a take-over between read and UPDATE, red when the backstop is removed.
